summary: BacDive openly serves one curated cell-shape class, gram stain, size and physiological/sequence identity per strain for >100,000 strains, which covers the identifiability half of the test; no repository dataset found images many bacterial species across growth phase, medium and preparation. IDR idr0065 (19,077 E. coli images) and a Dryad Pasteuria ramosa morphotype set give within-species shape variation for single species only.
next_step: Pull BacDive shape/size fields for all strains via the open API to tabulate how many species share each shape class; for the within-strain variation half, compile growth-phase shape measurements from single-species imaging studies (BioStudies/IDR) or collect new images.
obstacles_confirmed: Most strains carry one curated shape, not a series across life stages and preparations.
No multi-species, multi-condition bacterial morphology image dataset surfaced in BioImage Archive, Zenodo, DataCite or Dryad searches.
